context: A boss reviews a business strategy
purpose: Teach: 名声/攻める/前身/模試/近世/廃案/本州/鎖国

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の名声、長年で築いてきた。
lines.en: The company's reputation in this industry—it was built carefully over decades.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Slight pause after the dash. Low register, steady cadence. The weight of accumulated time in each phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外市場、攻める方針で進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward with an aggressive strategy in the overseas market.
lines.style: Attentive, nodding in the voice. Efficient delivery without rushing. Demonstrating he's taken the point and is ready to act on it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の前身、商社時代の精神、忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't forget the spirit of our predecessor company—the trading house mentality that built us.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Not a lecture, but a correction. Eyes steady. The kind of statement that lands because it's said simply, without inflection.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内模試、人事評価に組み込んでいます。
lines.en: Understood. We've already woven it into the internal assessments and HR evaluations.
lines.style: Clear, methodical report-back. Slight lift at the end—showing he's ahead of the expectation, not behind it. Professional competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 近世商人の信用、現代でも通用する。
lines.en: The trust that merchants built in the early modern period—it still holds weight today.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical. Slower pace. Gaze seems inward first, then outward. The conviction of someone who has seen this tested and proven true.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。承認、廃案にならないよう、慎重に進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll move carefully to ensure the proposal gets approval and doesn't get shelved.
lines.style: Reassuring in its precision. Calm acknowledgment of the stakes. Not rushing to close—leaving space for Hiroshi to add anything more.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本州内のチェーン、強化しろ。
lines.en: Strengthen the chain operations here on Honshu.
lines.style: Direct command, but not harsh. Brief. The confidence of someone who expects it to be understood and executed without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。グローバル化と鎖国的閉鎖性、バランスが鍵です。
lines.en: Right. The real challenge is balancing globalization with the need to maintain strong domestic foundations.
lines.style: Thoughtful closing. Acknowledging the complexity Hiroshi has implied without saying it outright. Settling into the work ahead.
